plugins.name: onepassword
plugins.description: Reach 1Password secrets behind a Touch ID gate on every use, and keep secret values out of the model transcript.

plugins.name: linode
plugins.description: Work with Linode inside the project's tag boundary: resources are created with the project tag, and writes to another project's resources are refused.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Adversarial review with several independent Claude models: run the reviewers, reproduce every finding before trusting it, and turn attack inputs into tests. Includes a script that tells a quiet sub-agent from a hung one.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Run OpenAI's Codex CLI non-interactively as a second opinion, and report every finding it returns to the user verbatim before touching any code.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Run Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) headless as a second-opinion code reviewer, refuse to trust its exit code, and report every finding to the user verbatim before touching any code.

plugins.name: k8s-local
plugins.description: Run a project's whole stack on a local Kubernetes cluster: build straight into the cluster's image store, refuse any context whose name and API server address are not local, and keep the datastores throwaway.

plugins.name: vinvoice
plugins.description: Issue Vietnamese e-invoices through Viettel S-Invoice: the verified API contract, a pipeline that cannot file one sale twice, and a read-only probe CLI that refuses to create an invoice.
